In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the underlaying of D2D communication in cellular networks has a positive impact in terms of spectral and energy efficiency.
underlay D2D communication is a promising technique that can significantly enhance the network performance.
the D2D mode selection scheme is crucial to the cellular network performance and the truncated channel inversion power scheme provides the best performance for the D2D communication mode.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the D2D communication is beneficial for cellular networks, but the performance gain depends on the network configuration and the traffic load.

the underlaying cellular D2D communication is able to improve both the cellular and the D2D network performance, while maintaining the cellular network performance at a level that is comparable to that of a conventional cellular network without D2D communication.
the D2D-enabled cellular networks with the proposed power control and mode selection scheme can achieve a significant performance gain compared to the conventional cellular networks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cellular network throughput can be improved significantly by carefully designing the mode selection scheme.
D2D-enabled networks can achieve a higher spectral efficiency than conventional cellular networks, but at the cost of increased interference and lower energy efficiency.
